gloss: to bring and share; to each contribute

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {持|も}ち{寄|よ}りませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {持|も}ち{寄|よ}っていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {持|も}ち{寄|よ}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to bring (something) and share; to each contribute; to pool together
definitions.explanation: When multiple people each bring something to a gathering — food, ideas, money, or resources — to share or combine. Implies a cooperative effort where each person contributes their part.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ち{寄|よ}って⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We each brought a dish and had a party.

examples.japanese: ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ち{寄|よ}って⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}おう→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧。
examples.english: Let's each bring our ideas and discuss them together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ち{寄|よ}って、⟦{炊|た}き{出|だ}し→炊き出し：17293_takidashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Local residents each contributed ingredients and set up a soup kitchen.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to hold/carry) + ⟦{寄|よ}る→寄る：02440_yoru⟧ (to approach/gather). Godan verb conjugating as {持|も}ち{寄|よ}らない, {持|も}ち{寄|よ}ります, etc. The key nuance is that multiple people each bring something to a common place.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ち{寄|よ}る: to each bring a dish (potluck)
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ち{寄|よ}る: to bring together opinions
- ⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ち{寄|よ}る: to pool funds
- ⟦{知恵|ちえ}→知恵：03428_chie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ち{寄|よ}る: to pool wisdom

USAGE:
⟦{持|も}ち{寄|よ}り→持ち寄り：08471_mochiyori⟧ is the noun form, commonly seen in ⟦{持|も}ち{寄|よ}りパーティー→持ち寄りパーティー：26664_mochiyoripaatii⟧ (potluck party). The pattern ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ち{寄|よ}る always implies that multiple people are participating.
